To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a passively mode-locked thulium-doped all fiber laser is demonstrated utilizing our fabricated micro fiber based polarization beam splitter (PBS) as an artificial saturable absorbers (SAs).
the microfiber based polarization splitters are capable of generating stable soliton pulses in the thulium-doped fiber lasers.
we have demonstrated the use of a microfiber based polarization splitter to mode-lock a thulium-doped fiber laser.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of microfiber based PBSs and their application to mode locked thuliam doped fiber lasers.
the fabrication of microfiber based PBSs and their applications in thulium doted fiber lasers.
the design, fabrication and characterization of a novel microfiber based polarization splitting structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the microfiber based polarization splitter is a very attractive and promising candidate as a saturable absorber, especially for the mode locked fiber laser system, and the microfiber based all fiber PBSs are also expected to be a very useful and important component in other fiber systems.

the microfiber based polarization splitters can be used to achieve both traditional soliton and dispersion managed soliton in a thulium doted fiber laser, which is the first report to our best knowledge, and also a significant step towards the application of microfiber based devices in mode locked fiber systems.
our fabricated microfiber PBSs are capable of achieving mode locking in a thulium doper fiber laser.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microfiber based all fiber PBS is a simple and effective way of realizing the mode locked fiber lasers.
we have successfully demonstrated the potential of our fabricated microfiber PBS in passively mode locking fiber lasers.
the microfiber based polarization splitting devices are promising for the development of compact and efficient all fiber laser systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microfiber based all fiber PBSs can be used as a polarization independent saturable absorber for mode locked fiber lasers.
the microfiber based polarization splitters can be used as a passive saturable absorber for mode locking fiber lasers.
microfiber based polarization splitters have great potential to be used in a wide range of optical applications.
